caption:
You can't watch your way to rhythm. 🥁

Same dream, two plans. One plays drums 10 minutes a day. One watches drum covers. Day 30, off beat again. Next day, he plays again. A year later: 98% on beat vs 912 covers watched.

Listen to the groove change.

Send this to a future drummer.

#drums #drummer #practice #discipline #motivation
